skill.summary: Detect and score B2B buying signals from LinkedIn job posts and company data, then generate personalized outreach messages for hot leads.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the LinkedIn B2B Buying Signal Detector skill.
- Automatically detects high-intent buying signals from LinkedIn job postings, company growth, and tech stack changes.
- Integrates multiple Apify actors to gather job, company, and news data; uses Claude AI to score intent and generate personalized outreach.
- Outputs a scored, ready-to-contact lead list with hyper-personalized email and LinkedIn messages.
- Supports CSV, JSON, Notion, and CRM integration for export and workflow automation.
- Includes Slack, Notion, Airtable, and HubSpot/Pipedrive integration options for lead alerts and management.
